|game1= arma3

|descr= Set max. wind overall wind changes in time. A time of zero means there will be an immediate change. A wind level of zero is minimal changes and a wind level of one means that wind can change rapidly.

|p1= time: [[Number]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]
